purchase.notes: Minimal entry; user only filled purchase price.

formula.expression: all_in_total = purchase_price + shipping + tax + fees + supplies
formula.note: Optional fields defaulted to 0; only purchase_price entered by user.

requiredFields.note: These three are REQUIRED. User saved Purchased with purchase_price only.

optionalFieldsOmitted.note: User skipped these; CRM did not block save.

crmBehavior.note: Assumption: purchase_price is sufficient to save. Optional lines may be required later per founder decision.

founderDecision.question: Require at least one optional cost line (shipping, tax, fees, or supplies) for private beta testers (flippers)?
founderDecision.spikeRecommendation: Optional to reduce friction; founder may override.
founderDecision.impactIfRequired: Users must enter or acknowledge $0 for at least one breakdown.

_meta.description: MOCK EXAMPLE — Minimal all-in cost entry: purchase_price only. User tapped Purchased, entered $15.00 purchase price, skipped optional fields. CRM saved with shipping/tax/fees/supplies defaulted to $0.00. All-in total is $15.00. User may later realize actual all-in was higher; they can note in draft or edit if enabled. Amounts shown as decimal strings for readability; persist minor units later.
